flawless: Atlantis does not deign to bleed. Kneel before the tide, little landling.
My merfolk swam through your defences as if they were open water.
Every merfolk grows mighty in my presence. You merely grew tired.
solid: You troubled the waters, I grant you. The depths remain mine.
A few of my court will need tending. The crown is untouched.
close: By the drowned kings, you nearly swept away my throne!
My people are scattered and my crown askew. Leave the shallows, landling.
